capabilities: Record online meetings as separate microphone and system-audio tracks
Transcribe audio and video with local Whisper models
Separate and label speakers by diarization
Remember named speakers by voice for later meetings
Summarize transcripts with a local Ollama model and insert them into notes
extras: Desktop-only. First run installs a Python environment (about 1.5 GB on Linux, 0.6 GB on macOS) and downloads Whisper (about 3 GB) plus speaker models; recordings and voice prints are stored outside the vault, and voice prints are biometric data.
problem: Obsidian cannot capture meeting audio or turn it into a speaker-labelled transcript and summary inside a note.
summary: Desktop plugin that records online or in-person meetings and writes a speaker-labelled transcript and summary into a note using local models.
